cd /workspace/MERGEEVENTINGESTION && git commit -m "feat: add Stockholm venues source with honest naming
- Add stockholm-venues source (previously named 'stockholm')
- Renamed to clarify this is Stockholm venues, NOT stockholm.com
- stockholm.com is blocked by Cloudflare, cannot be scraped
- Source contains sample events for Stockholm-based venues
- Uses SOURCE_KEY constant for consistent naming"
